انضبطت (form VII)
# اِنْضَبَطْتُ (inḍabaṭtu) /in.dˤa.batˤ.tu/: first-person singular past active of اِنْضَبَطَ (inḍabaṭa)
# اِنْضَبَطْتَ (inḍabaṭta) /in.dˤa.batˤ.ta/: second-person masculine singular past active of اِنْضَبَطَ (inḍabaṭa)
# اِنْضَبَطْتِ (inḍabaṭti) /in.dˤa.batˤ.ti/: second-person feminine singular past active of اِنْضَبَطَ (inḍabaṭa)
# اِنْضَبَطَتْ (inḍabaṭat) /in.dˤa.ba.tˤat/: thir
maddeler.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
